title: GIMMICK: Globally Inclusive Multimodal Multitask Cultural Knowledge Benchmarking
reasoning: The benchmark explicitly evaluates model knowledge on 'rituals' and 'religion' as target cultural aspects. The underlying dataset from UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage project includes many entries tied to spiritual traditions, religious festivals, sacred mandates, and religious rituals (e.g., relics of saints, protective deities, and the 'Law of Origin').
